sloka: भार्यया च महाभाग सीतया अनुगतो वशी ।दिन क्षये महातेजाः प्रभ एव दिवाकरः ॥४-४-११॥
transliteration: bhāryayā ca mahābhāga sītayā anugato vaśī ।dina kṣaye mahātejāḥ prabha eva divākaraḥ ॥4-4-11॥

translations.english: 'This glorious Rama was followed by his wife, Sita, like the rays of the effulgent Sun follow him to the end of the day.
